layers.name: Domain Model
layers.description: Core domain entities, value objects, and repository interfaces for cargo, handling, location, and voyage.

layers.name: Application Services
layers.description: Use-case orchestration: booking, routing, tracking, handling registration, and pathfinding services.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Persistence
layers.description: Django ORM models, repository implementations, and app-level model modules.

layers.name: Interfaces (Views & API)
layers.description: Django views, forms, URL routing, REST endpoints, and tracking/map adapters.

layers.name: UI Templates
layers.description: HTML templates, including HTMX partials, for booking, tracking, and admin pages.

layers.name: Database Migrations
layers.description: Django schema migrations for each bounded context.

layers.name: Project Config & Tooling
layers.description: Settings, root URLs, app configs, composition roots, management commands, data migration tools, packages, and docs.

tour.title: Project Overview & Vocabulary
tour.description: Cargotracker models cargo shipping — booking, routing, handling and tracking — as a Django app organised in DDD layers (domain, application, infrastructure, interfaces). The handling glossary defines the shared ubiquitous language; urls.py is the web entry point that mounts each bounded context.
tour.languageLesson: Django's root URLconf uses include() to delegate URL prefixes to each app, keeping contexts decoupled.

tour.title: Configuration & Runtime
tour.description: settings.py wires installed apps and databases; wsgi.py/asgi.py expose the app to servers.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate root is the heart of the domain, with its tracking id, route specification, itinerary and delivery progress as value objects.
tour.languageLesson: Frozen dataclasses are a common way to express immutable DDD value objects in Python.

tour.title: Locations & Voyages
tour.description: Supporting domains: UN/LOCODE locations and voyages made of scheduled carrier movements, each with a repository interface.

tour.title: Persistence Layer
tour.description: Infrastructure adapters implement domain repositories using Django ORM models, keeping the domain framework-free.
tour.languageLesson: Repository interfaces in domain/ are implemented in infrastructure/, inverting dependencies.

tour.title: Booking Application Services
tour.description: Booking use cases: registering cargo, changing specifications, assigning routes, and the dashboard.

tour.title: Pathfinder Routing
tour.description: A separate pathfinder context computes candidate transit paths, exposed via an API that booking consumes.

tour.title: Booking Web Interface
tour.description: Views and templates for the wizard, dashboard and route selection screens.
tour.languageLesson: Django templates extend a base layout via {% extends %} and {% block %}.

tour.title: Handling Events
tour.description: Handling events record what happened to cargo; registration attempts are accepted via REST and processed asynchronously, updating cargo delivery.

tour.title: Composition Roots
tour.description: composition.py modules assemble concrete repositories and services for each context.

tour.title: Tracking & Live Map
tour.description: Public tracking shows status, history, ETA and next activity; an admin live map displays cargo positions.

tour.title: Management Commands & Data Tools
tour.description: Commands seed sample data, process handling attempts, and export/load data snapshots.
